text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On our way back from going out with Taiki Shuttle, we stopped by the shopping district. And then—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm? What is that over there, YES?
Fuu... fuu... fuku-hiku?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking around, the shopping district's lottery draw was underway.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey you two, looking all close over there!
Care to give it a try~?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! So that's the lottery tombola!!
I've always wanted to try the lottery!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer!
Let's get ourselves some big treasuuure!
choice_data_list: First, we have to shop to get raffle tickets.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right!
Speaking of what I want right now...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It hit me like a flash, yes!
I'll go buy lots and lots of milk, yeeees!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And with that, I received one lottery ticket.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The chance is one-time only...!
Mmm, that is quite severe, yes...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: However, the grand prize is what you really wanna show for the show!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whooooooo!!
Come here, come here, grand priiiiize!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a spirited shout, the lottery wheel spun vigorously.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay--!!
I'm so haaaappy~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We did it~~~!
Let's make a plan right away, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Of course it is! Trainer and I are in the same boat, sharing the same fate!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"When should we go!? Tomorrow!? Day after tomorrow!?
Right now!? Okay, let's go!!"
choice_data_list: H-Hold on! Let's go another day instead!
W-Wait! Let's go another day instead!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Another time...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm-mm? Could it be that you're full of energy
and have no fatigue to get rid of, YES~?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs when you're not even tired is MOTTAINAI!
That's the Japanese soul for ya!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay, got it!!
Let's go whenever the time is right! That's a promise~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saving it as a reward after overcoming something makes it even more exciting—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Or so I had thought, but... In any case,
I ended up holding on to her hot springs trip voucher.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Noooo!
Just one more breath and I would've had itttt!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, that's a huge, energy-packed
hamburg steak, isn't it, yes~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, big meat dishes
remind me of my family~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, since we're here, let's tell
the Familia about drawing the lottery!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer-san, you too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Say, cheese!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she wolfed down the deluxe Salisbury steak,
gaining a fresh burst of energy for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~gh, so close, yes~!
Too baaad!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Still, it is a very glossy and delicious-looking carrot, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, let's invite everyone from the dorms
and throw a BBQ party!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's gonna be super-duper fun, yes!!
Wooo! Hurry up, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night's BBQ party, centered around massive piles of carrots, turned out to be an absolute blast.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Mmm!? 3rd prize!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Uuuuugh...! That's just a liiittle too frustrating, desu neee...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!!
I'm gonna go shopping one more time!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Our budget is tight, so 1st prize...
no, at least 2nd prize, please...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I somehow managed to persuade her out of her lottery frenzy,
and practically dragged her on the way back home.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... So severe...
Reality isn't sweet at all, is it...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So this is... the lottery's baptism of fire...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Together with Taiki Shuttle, I sank into deep despair...
